i1.title: Azzaro Chrome Azure Eau de Toilette 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A bright, sea-fresh take on Azzaro Chrome.

Azzaro Chrome Azure Eau de Toilette 100ml is a fresh aquatic fragrance for men, launched in 2024. Green Italian bergamot opens brightly, French lavender gives an aromatic heart, and it settles on cool marine notes.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Bergamot
  • Heart: Lavender
  • Base: Marine Notes

Key details

  • Brand: Azzaro
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Aromatic · Aquatic · Fresh
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A bright opening of Italian bergamot
  • A clean, aromatic heart of French lavender
  • A cool marine finish
  • Fresh and easy to wear every day

FAQ

What does Chrome Azure smell like?

Bergamot first, then lavender, finishing with marine notes.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

seo.description: Azzaro Chrome Azure Eau de Toilette 100ml: bergamot over lavender and marine notes. Free UK delivery over £40.

i2.title: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau de Toilette 100ml
